# Support and usability findings

- Window: 2026-01-01 through 2026-05-31
- Source owner: Customer Operations
- Authority: observed support evidence; not an approved product decision

- 18 tickets report that users confuse the current owner with the person who
  last updated an exception.
- 11 tickets report losing resolution notes after a failed save.
- 9 tickets concern dispatchers reaching a server-side permission error after
  attempting to reassign a compliance hold.
- 7 tickets report that users interpret `Done` as final even when the exception
  is later reopened.
- 5 moderated sessions found that users scan SLA and owner before carrier and
  location when deciding what to open.
- 4 sessions at 1024×768 showed missed bulk-action feedback because it appeared
  below the visible table region.

The counts reflect reported cases, not population prevalence. They may support
prioritization and hypotheses but do not prove a universal user behavior.
